scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix apps/api && npm ci --prefix apps/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web & wait
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/api && npm run lint --prefix apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/api && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
